items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: Gelo Nunes was another one. Quite a few of the old times, it was real musicians.

ctx.x: Well, to get into Leonce's life a little, did he study music?

Yeah, with his ears. With his ears. I'll tell you what, not that he was my brother like I told Crawford. Not that he was my brother. But whatever the heck he put his hands on and he wanted to play, he played. And it didn't matter what he played, he used to go around the nigger bands and listen to the execution. Oh, he'd come home and play it. If he went to the niggers and heard one piece of music, he'd come home and play it. That's just how good a head he had. He could have gone on with Ted Lewis. Ted Lewis…
Well, that generation is forgotten today, pretty much. I know.
